_note: RFC 9421 proof-of-possession signature-base vectors for the bound-retrieval GET (ADR-013 D2/D4). Pins the byte-identical @target-uri signature base across every implementation that builds it: the SDK's TS signatureBase, which the edge verifier calls (src/edge/tests/node/signature-base.test.ts); the Go base builder the edge double verifies with (internal/httpsig.PoPSignatureBase) — the Go SIGNER is the protocol module's now, and what remains app-side is the verifying half; the e2e harness signer (tests/e2e/harness/rampsig.py, via test_rampsig.py); and the TS test signer (src/edge/tests/helpers/ed25519.ts). Each entry's expected_base is exactly what the fetcher signs and the edge reconstructs; a divergence in line order, quoting, or the params string rejects every bound fetch. @target-uri is the URL VERBATIM as minted — never re-serialized through a URL parser, which is why every producer here takes a string. The last vector uses the RFC 8032 Ed25519 test key as the bound agent_id. For the emitted header values rather than the base alone, see pop-sign-vectors.json.
